Title: Revelationum S. Brigittae libri tres posteriores, a Consalvo Duranto episcopo Feretrano novis notationibus variisque lectionibus locupletati; una cum Regula S. Salvatoris, Sermone angelico et quatuor orationibus; tomus II
Creator: Birgitta of Sweden; notes by Consalvo Duranti (title page)
Publisher: Romae: apud Ludovicum Grignanum (title page, read on the page image, leaf n4)
Publication Date: 1628 (title page, MDCXXVIII, read on the page image, leaf n4; the OCR damages the numerals)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1628); the archive.org record carries the Public Domain Mark (licenseurl creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/), and the imprint date agrees
Language: lat
Source: archive.org item bub_gb_2_8rGlQ7NJkC, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-15 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (2,859,213) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1628, out of US copyright by date. OCR quality: the Latin of the text is fair, with the long s read as f; Duranti's notes are poor. Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: The second volume of the edition whose first is held (Books I-V). Book VI from OCR line 113 to 20113; Book VII from 21273 to 28493; Book VIII, the 'Liber caelestis imperatoris ad reges', from 30774 to 38241; the Rule of the Saviour from 38535 to 40609; the Sermo angelicus to 44176; four prayers from about 44293; the Revelationes extravagantes from about 45390 to about 52720; the short Life ('Vita abbreviata') with miracles from about 52733; a Life of her daughter Catherine from about 58176; indexes from about 62015 to the end. Duranti's notes are interleaved and are not Birgitta's voice.
